help.subtitle: Learn how to manage your tabs efficiently

welcome.title: Welcome to TabQuest!
welcome.description: Transform your browsing experience with smart tab management. Follow these 3 steps to get started.

step1.title: Open Side Panel
step1.description: Click the TabQuest extension icon to open the side panel. It stays open while you browse, giving you quick access to all features.

step2.title: Create Categories
step2.description: Click the 🏷️ button to create custom categories like Work, Shopping, or Learning. Choose colors to easily identify them.

step3.title: Organize Tabs
step3.description: Click 'Smart Organize' to automatically group your tabs by category. TabQuest uses AI to understand your browsing patterns.

smartOrganize.title: Smart Organize
smartOrganize.description: One-click automatic tab organization powered by AI
details: Analyzes tab URLs and titles to determine categories
Creates Chrome tab groups with custom colors
Preserves system tabs and video meetings
smartOrganize.example: Example: Click 'Smart Organize' to group all your shopping tabs, work tabs, and social media tabs automatically.

categoryManagement.title: Category Management
categoryManagement.description: Create and customize categories to match your workflow
details: Drag and drop to reorder categories
categoryManagement.example: Example: Create a 'Shopping' category with orange color, and all Amazon, eBay tabs will automatically use it.

snapshots.title: Snapshots
snapshots.description: Save and restore your tab states instantly
details: Save current tab arrangement with one click
Saved locally, never sent to servers
snapshots.example: Example: Save a snapshot before a meeting, switch to meeting tabs, then restore your work tabs after.

undoRedo.title: Undo/Redo
undoRedo.description: Never worry about mistakes - undo any organization
details: Full undo support for Smart Organize
Restores exact tab positions and groups
undoRedo.example: Example: Accidentally organized tabs? Click 'Undo' to instantly restore the previous arrangement.

aiInsights.title: AI Insights
aiInsights.description: Get smart recommendations based on your browsing
details: Detects duplicate tabs to save memory
Suggests when to organize many tabs
aiInsights.example: Example: TabQuest detects 5 duplicate tabs and suggests closing them to free up 200MB of memory.

tabGroups.title: Tab Groups Viewer
tabGroups.description: View and manage existing Chrome tab groups
details: See all tab groups at a glance
tabGroups.example: Example: Export your 'Work Project' tab group and share it with teammates via JSON file.

domainMapping.title: Domain Auto-Mapping
domainMapping.description: When you assign a category to a domain (like github.com → Development), all tabs from that domain automatically use the same category.

colorCoding.title: Color Coding
colorCoding.description: Use different colors for different contexts: Purple for work, Green for learning, Orange for shopping. Visual colors help you quickly identify tab groups.

autoSync.title: Chrome Sync
autoSync.description: Your categories and preferences sync across devices if Chrome Sync is enabled. Your tab snapshots stay local for privacy.

multiLanguage.title: Multi-Language
multiLanguage.description: TabQuest supports English, Korean (한국어), and Japanese (日本語). Switch languages from the settings menu (⚙️).

dataManagement.title: Data Management
dataManagement.description: Clear local data anytime from Settings > Clear Data. This removes snapshots and AI insights but keeps your categories.

privacy.title: Privacy First
privacy.description: All your data stays on your device. TabQuest never sends your browsing data to external servers. 100% local, 100% private.
